raw.title: Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d)
raw.description:
What is Anori Tech doing?

The world talks about batteries, cells and the energy transition. Almost nobody talks about the Battery Management System (BMS) that makes them work.

As battery applications multiply, from robotics and mobility to data centers and grid-scale storage, BMS complexity is exploding. Legacy BMS architectures were never built for this: too rigid to keep up with new requirements, they've turned the BMS into the bottleneck of battery development.

We're building something different: a novel software-defined BMS architecture combined with an AI-driven configuration process. It gets battery manufacturers the right BMS for their exact use case within days, regardless of application or cell chemistry.

We're building the battery management system platform of tomorrow. Delivered in days, not years.

Join us and shape one of the fastest growing markets in the energy sector: The BMS market.

Our Motivation

At Anori Tech, we believe everything is energy, and progress runs on it. With Anori we actively shape the energy transition: from oil to electric, from low to high efficiency. We need batteries for this transition and almost all batteries need a BMS. We strive for Shenzhen speed and German engineering quality. Our objective: put Europe back on the map in the race for the energy transition and build technical leadership out of Hamburg.

About the Role

A BMS is only as good as what it knows about the battery. As our Algorithm Engineer, you'll develop the algorithms that tell the Anori BMS what is happening inside the cells: state of charge, state of health and balancing. And you won't stop at the concept: you'll design algorithms, implement them in our embedded Rust firmware and validate them on real hardware. Later on, the role grows into the cloud, where data pipelines and fleet analytics will build on the models you create today. You'll work closely with Stefan, our CTO, and our firmware and hardware engineers.

Start date: from January 1, 2027

What You'll Do

  • Develop the algorithms that estimate SoC and SoH for different cell chemistries and applications

  • Design balancing strategies that fit the hardware and use case

  • Build battery models (e.g. equivalent circuit models) and parameterize them from measurement data with statistical rigor

  • Implement your algorithms directly in the embedded Rust firmware, efficient enough for constrained hardware

  • Design experiments and evaluation methodologies: analyze failure modes, quantify trade-offs between accuracy, robustness and compute cost

  • Support in building data pipelines and fleet analytics in the cloud

What You Bring

Must have

  • Hands-on experience with state of charge and state of health estimation, shown in a product, publication or substantial project. For example Kalman-type filters, H∞ filters, observers, or coulomb counting with model-based correction

  • Deep understanding of battery behavior and modeling, e.g. equivalent circuit models, hysterisis, ageing or also physics based models

  • Experience implementing numerical algorithms on embedded, constrained hardware (e.g. in Rust or C/C++ - heads-up our firmware is written in Rust, and we'll help you get up to speed)

  • Strong Python skills for modeling, simulation and data analysis

  • Critical, analytical, systematic thinking: you reason from first principles, make your assumptions explicit and challenge existing paradigms

Strongly preferred

  • Experience with cell balancing algorithms and their effects

  • Working with real cell data from test benches or cyclers

  • Signal processing fundamentals: FIR/IIR filter design, sampling and aliasing, noise characterization of sensor data

Nice to have

  • Data pipelines, fleet analytics or cloud experience

  • Machine learning methods for battery data, for example data-driven state of health estimation or anomaly detection

  • Model-based systems engineering and requirements engineering (the skills, not the paper)

You don't tick every box? Apply anyway. No one matches a job description 100%. If this role excites you and you are motivated to grow yourself into it, we want to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Work on a product with purpose that redefines the state of art: our product is a key part to enable competitive battery energy storage.

  • Work directly with the founding team on decisions that shape the company. The team is small, so your ideas will matter. A lot.

  • Challenging engineering in an industrial, but research-near environment. We bring research into the industry.

  • A modern stack and methods: Rust, MBSE, everything as code, and the best tools and techniques for the job, chosen on merit.

  • To be both supported and challenged: room to grow, and the expectation that you will.

You might be a fit if

  • You hold yourself to a high standard and don’t settle for "good enough."

  • You want to have a big say in what the Anori BMS looks like and how it works

  • You are eager to try out new tools and enjoy incorporating AI into your work to make your life easier and more productive

  • You are excited about startups and all the opportunities and uncertainties that come with it

  • You want to be an active part in accelerating the energy transition in Europe

  • You are comfortable with English as a working language

  • You are happy to be in the office most of the time because for fast decisions we need to be in the same room. We expect you to be in the office at least 3 days / week

Interview Process

  1. First Call A short chat with one of our founders. We'll get to know your background and answer any questions you have about Anori Tech. 30 min

  2. Deep Dive with Case Study (on-site) A meeting with Stefan, our CTO. We want to understand how you work and talk through your past projects. The meeting also includes a small case study, and we will send you some context information for it beforehand. 2 - 3 hours

  3. Meet the Team (on-site) Time to meet your future colleagues! In this meeting we get to know each other. This is also the time to discuss final details like salary. 1 - 2 hours

The on-site meetings will be at our lab at the Bahrenfeld Startup Lab: Luruper Hauptstraße 1, 22547 Altona

You also want to become an Anori? We cannot wait to meet you. Go and click the apply button. Don’t be shy, we are nice.

P.S. Extra bonus if you tell us what your favorite type of tea is.

description: Sie kennen SAP aus dem laufenden Betrieb, bis in Tabellen, Logs und Transporte? Über unseren Mandanten Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis, und die IT soll dieses Wachstum mit stabilen Systemen tragen. Warum diese Rolle? Das SAP-System läuft auf ECC 6.0, ist über Jahre gewachsen und soll auf S/4HANA umgestellt werden. Die Basis betreibt ein externer Dienstleister, in den Fachbereichen entsteht ein Key-User-Konzept. Gesucht wird die Person, die das Ganze technisch zusammenhält. • Weil Sie die Verantwortung für ein SAP-Backend tragen, das zuverlässig läuft. • Weil Sie den Weg von ECC zu S/4HANA von Anfang an begleiten. • Weil Sie Zuständigkeiten klären und Strukturen schaffen, die bleiben. Das sind Ihre Aufgaben • Sie behalten Hintergrundjobs, IDoc-Verarbeitung, RFC-Verbindungen, EDI-Strecken und angebundene Drittsysteme im Blick. Fehler analysieren Sie über Dumps, Logs und Traces und verfolgen sie bis zur Lösung. • Sie koordinieren den Basis-Dienstleister bei Upgrades, Patches und Performance-Themen, später auch beim Wechsel auf S/4HANA, und fordern Ergebnisse ein. • Sie prüfen Anforderungen und legen fest, ob Sie selbst umsetzen, den Dienstleister beauftragen oder die Aufgabe an den Fachbereich geben. • Sie unterstützen die Fachbereiche beim Aufbau ihrer Key-User-Rollen. • Sie erledigen selbst Benutzer und Rollen, SAPscript- und Smartforms-Anpassungen, Jobeinplanung, Systemnachrichten und kleinere technische Änderungen. • Sie halten Systemlandschaft und Abläufe schriftlich fest, sodass Wissen im Unternehmen bleibt. Zur Einordnung: Installation, Datenbank und Betriebssystem verantwortet der Basis-Dienstleister. Für die operative Steuerung und den weiteren Ausbau unserer Projekte suchen wir ab sofort einen Automotive-Projektmanager (m/w/d). title: E-Commerce Manager (m/w/d)
description: Du willst unseren Onlinehandel nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv weiterentwickeln? Du erkennst Potenziale, hast Ideen und möchtest sie auch selbst umsetzen? Dann könnte K-Active genau der richtige Ort für dich sein. Bei uns dreht sich seit über 25 Jahren alles um Therapie, Rehabilitation, Sport und Bewegung. Unsere Produkte werden in Praxen, Kliniken und Vereinen eingesetzt und über unsere Vertriebspartner in mehr als 50 Ländern sowie über unsere Onlineshops und Amazon verkauft. Und wir haben online noch viel vor. Unsere Shops weiterentwickeln, Marktplätze ausbauen, Prozesse verbessern und unsere Produkte sichtbarer machen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt, unternehmerisch denkt und unseren Onlinehandel mit eigenen Ideen voranbringt. Und weil uns Flexibilität wichtig ist: Du entscheidest, ob du 36 Stunden an vier Tagen oder 40 Stunden an fünf Tagen arbeiten möchtest. Das kannst du bei uns bewegen Onlineshops: Unsere Shopware-6-Shops betreuen, weiterentwickeln und externe Dienstleister koordinieren. Marktplätze: Amazon und weitere Plattformen ausbauen, Produktlistings optimieren und neue Verkaufspotenziale erschließen. Systeme und Prozesse: Shopware, Xentral und Verkaufskanäle besser miteinander verknüpfen und Produktdaten optimieren. Online-Sichtbarkeit: SEO, Produkttexte, Ratgeber und Bildmaterial gezielt weiterentwickeln. Wirtschaftlichkeit: Umsätze, Deckungsbeiträge und Rentabilität analysieren und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ableiten. Eigeninitiative: Ideen einbringen, Projekte selbstständig vorantreiben und unseren Onlinehandel aktiv gestalten. Was du mitbringst Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im E-Commerce, idealerweise mit Shopware 6, ERP-Systemen und Amazon Seller Central. Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge, denkst unternehmerisch und erkennst, wo sich Prozesse und Ergebnisse verbessern lassen. KI-Werkzeuge gehören für dich zum Arbeitsalltag. Du nutzt sie gezielt, um Aufgaben effizienter zu lösen und bessere Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Du musst nicht jedes System perfekt beherrschen. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, eigenständig Lösungen entwickelst und deine Ideen auch umsetzt. Marketingplanung & Umsetzung: Gemeinsam mit dem Head of Marketing entwickelst du unseren Marketingplan weiter, koordinierst Maßnahmen und stellst die konsequente und termingerechte Umsetzung sicher. Partner & Key Accounts: Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere PR-Agentur und koordinierst Marketingaktivitäten mit Handelspartnern und Key Accounts – national wie international. Gleichzeitig bist du wichtiger Ansprechpartner für angrenzende Abteilungen wie Vertrieb und Produktmanagement. Events & Brand Experience: Ob internationale Messen, Händlerveranstaltungen oder eigene Events – du begleitest unsere Aktivitäten nicht nur aus dem Büro, sondern bist auch vor Ort dabei und packst selbst mit an. Qualifikation Marketing-Know-how: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Marketing mit, idealerweise in einer vielseitigen Position. Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation oder BWL ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Leadership-Potenzial: Du kannst Menschen begeistern, Aufgaben koordinieren und Verantwortung übernehmen. Erste Führungserfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du hinterfragst Bestehendes und bringst aktiv neue Ideen ein. Digital Mindset: Du bist offen für neue Technologien, digitale Tools und KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen. Organisationstalent: Du arbeitest strukturiert, behältst auch bei parallelen Projekten den Überblick und setzt die richtigen Prioritäten. Bike Passion & Produktverständnis: Du interessierst dich für Fahrräder und unsere Branche. Du bist motiviert, dir ein tiefes Verständnis unserer Bikes, Technologien und Zielgruppen anzueignen und dieses Wissen gezielt in deine Arbeit einfließen zu lassen. Kommunikationsstärke: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch – sowohl intern als auch mit internationalen Partnern. Flexibilität & Reisebereitschaft: Du bist gerne unterwegs und bringst eine Reisebereitschaft von ca. 20–30% für Events, Messen und Partnertermine mit. Benefits Familiäres Team, starke Marke: Bei R Raymon Bicycles erwartet dich ein herzliches, motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echter Hands-on-Kultur. Bike-Benefit: Dein Bike, dein Ride: Leihe dir für bis zu ein Jahr ein Fahrrad oder E-Bike aus unserem aktuellen Sortiment – nahezu kostenfrei und mit flexiblen Optionen im Anschluss. Dienstrad-Leasing: Dein Bike für den Alltag – langfristig nutzbar, inklusive 10 % Zuschuss zur monatlichen Leasingrate sowie steuerlichen Vorteilen. Zeit für dich: Genieße 30 Tage Jahresurlaub für Erholung, Abenteuer und neue Energie. Zukunft sichern: Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge inklusive 25 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss – für eine finanziell abgesicherte Zukunft. Gesundheit zählt: Wir unterstützen dich mit einer privaten Zusatzabsicherung im Rahmen einer betrieblichen Krankenversicherung. Energie tanken: Kalte und warme Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir kostenlos zur Verfügung. Gemeinschaft, die trägt: Freu dich auf regelmäßige Team-Events, gemeinsame Erlebnisse und echten Zusammenhalt. Mitgestalten statt nur mitarbeiten: Bringe deine Ideen ein und gestalte aktiv unsere gemeinsame Zukunft. Aus Fehlern lernen: Eine offene und positive Fehlerkultur sorgt für Vertrauen, Entwicklung und echtes Teamwork. DU BIST EIN GUTER FIT? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnissen. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: About the role 0G is hiring its first dedicated DevOps engineer to own our cloud platform end to end: infrastructure, deployments, networking, security hygiene and cost. Today that work is spread across several developers. Our platform runs on five providers: Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Cloudflare and Vercel. It includes: Validator, seed, RPC, and archive nodes for our mainnet and testnet Confidential-computing (TEE) workloads, GPU machines and storage nodes Kubernetes clusters and managed databases A global RPC load balancer at the edge, and our web apps All together, that is more than 200 virtual machines. You will be the person who knows what runs where, why it runs there, and what it costs. What you'll own You own the platform, from the network edge to the bill. Cloud operations: provisioning, upgrades, capacity and the full resource lifecycle on Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and AWS. That includes rightsizing and releasing what nobody uses. Kubernetes: run, upgrade and scale our clusters. Keep them on supported versions and design node pools, autoscaling and Spot capacity. Blockchain node fleet: operate validator, sentry, seed, RPC and archive nodes, including peering topology, snapshots, sync and client upgrades. Networking and edge: VPC design, load balancers, DNS, Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and WAF, and keeping internet egress deliberate and cheap. Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: every environment defined in Terraform or Pulumi. You design and run CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, covering builds, tests, security scans and releases from commit to production, with no manual steps. Observability and on-call: metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards, including control of metric cardinality. You also run incident response and write the postmortems. Security and access: least-privilege IAM across every provider, secrets management, and no databases or admin ports open to the internet. raw.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
raw.description:
About the role

0G is hiring its first dedicated DevOps engineer to own our cloud platform end to end: infrastructure, deployments, networking, security hygiene and cost. Today that work is spread across several developers.

Our platform runs on five providers: Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Cloudflare and Vercel. It includes:

  • Validator, seed, RPC, and archive nodes for our mainnet and testnet

  • Confidential-computing (TEE) workloads, GPU machines and storage nodes

  • Kubernetes clusters and managed databases

  • A global RPC load balancer at the edge, and our web apps

All together, that is more than 200 virtual machines. You will be the person who knows what runs where, why it runs there, and what it costs.

What you'll own

You own the platform, from the network edge to the bill.

  • Cloud operations: provisioning, upgrades, capacity and the full resource lifecycle on Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and AWS. That includes rightsizing and releasing what nobody uses.

  • Kubernetes: run, upgrade and scale our clusters. Keep them on supported versions and design node pools, autoscaling and Spot capacity.

  • Blockchain node fleet: operate validator, sentry, seed, RPC and archive nodes, including peering topology, snapshots, sync and client upgrades.

  • Networking and edge: VPC design, load balancers, DNS, Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and WAF, and keeping internet egress deliberate and cheap.

  • Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: every environment defined in Terraform or Pulumi. You design and run CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, covering builds, tests, security scans and releases from commit to production, with no manual steps.

  • Observability and on-call: metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards, including control of metric cardinality. You also run incident response and write the postmortems.

  • Security and access: least-privilege IAM across every provider, secrets management, and no databases or admin ports open to the internet.

  • Cost management: billing exports, budgets and alerts, tagging, a monthly cost review and commitment planning.

  • Developer enablement: templates, preview environments, documentation and support for the engineers who ship on the platform.

Our stack

Kubernetes: GKE, EKS, Helm, Ingress and Gateway API, autoscaling, RBAC, network policies

Networking: TCP/IP, subnets and CIDR, routing, NAT, L4 and L7 load balancers, DNS, TLS, firewalls, VPC peering

Google Cloud: Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud SQL, Cloud Run, IAM, Cloud Monitoring, billing export to BigQuery

Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Pulumi

CI/CD and containers: Jenkins or an equivalent (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Argo CD, Docker and BuildKit, container registries

Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Monitoring, CloudWatch, Alibaba CloudMonitor

Linux: Systems administration, systemd, disks and filesystems, performance debugging

Alibaba Cloud: ECS, VPC, NLB and ALB, ESSD disks, RDS, PolarDB, SAE, Cloud Firewall

AWS: EC2, EKS, RDS, ALB and NLB, Route 53, S3, Organizations

Cloudflare: DNS, Workers, Tunnels, WAF and rate limiting, Zero Trust

Databases (operations): PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, managed Kafka

Blockchain nodes: CometBFT-based chains, reth and other EVM clients, P2P networking

Vercel: Projects, builds, ISR, team access

Confidential computing: Intel TDX virtual machines on Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud

Must-haves

  • We want 5+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform roles, including 3+ years running production Kubernetes and owning CI/CD pipelines.

Kubernetes, in depth

  • Upgrading control planes and node pools with no downtime, and keeping clusters on supported versions.

  • Scheduling: requests and limits, affinity, taints and tolerations, priority, and eviction under node pressure.

  • Autoscaling with the HPA, cluster autoscaler or Karpenter, plus Spot or preemptible node pools for non-critical work.

  • Networking inside the cluster: CNI, Services, Ingress or Gateway API, network policies, and DNS within the cluster.

  • Security: RBAC, Pod Security, workload identity, and secrets that never sit in plain environment variables.

  • Stateful workloads: StatefulSets, persistent volumes and CSI drivers, and backup and restore.

  • Packaging and delivery with Helm or Kustomize, ideally through GitOps with Argo CD or Flux.

  • Debugging a failing pod, node or rollout from events, logs and metrics.

CI/CD, in depth

  • Pipeline design: you have built and run production CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Tekton). Pipelines are defined as code in a Jenkinsfile or workflow YAML, with shared libraries and reusable templates.

  • CI platform operations: running Jenkins controllers with ephemeral agents on Kubernetes, or self-hosted runners. That includes plugin and version upgrades, credential handling, and scaling build capacity.

  • Build pipelines: multi-service and monorepo builds with caching and parallel stages, and versioned artifacts. Container images built with Docker, BuildKit or Kaniko, including multi-architecture images, image scanning, SBOMs and signing.

  • Deployment pipelines: promotion from dev to staging to production with approvals and quality gates, plus blue-green, canary and fast rollback. GitOps with Argo CD or Flux, and database migrations as part of a release.

  • Infrastructure pipelines: Terraform or Pulumi plan and apply from CI, with policy checks and drift detection.

  • Pipeline security: short-lived credentials through OIDC federation or a secrets vault instead of long-lived keys, least-privilege deploy roles, and protected branches.

  • Release engineering for our chain: building and publishing node binaries and images, and coordinating rolling upgrades across validator and RPC fleets.

  • Delivery health: you track build time, build cost, flaky tests and DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore), and you cut wasted builds with ignore rules and caching.

Networking fundamentals

  • TCP/IP, subnetting and CIDR, routing, NAT, and the difference between L4 and L7 load balancing.

  • DNS, TLS and certificates, firewalls and security groups.

  • Private connectivity: VPC design, peering, private endpoints, and keeping internal traffic off public IPs.

  • Troubleshooting with dig, curl, mtr and tcpdump, and understanding what internet egress costs.

Also required

  • Production experience on at least two of Google Cloud, AWS and Alibaba Cloud, and willingness to learn the third quickly.

  • Terraform or Pulumi in production, plus scripting in Bash and in Python or Go.

  • A track record of cutting a cloud bill with data, through rightsizing, cleanup or commitments.

  • A security-first habit with production credentials, and clear written communication.

Nice to have

  • Running blockchain nodes in production, such as CometBFT validators and sentries, EVM archive or RPC nodes, and snapshot pipelines.

  • Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and Zero Trust at scale.

  • Alibaba Cloud on the international site, including its billing and support model.

  • Confidential computing (Intel TDX) and GPU workloads.

  • CKA or CKS certification, a FinOps certification, or experience moving a team between CI systems, such as Jenkins to GitHub Actions.

  • Go or Rust, enough to read and patch the services you operate.

What we offer

  • Purpose: The opportunity to contribute to making AI a public good

  • Growth: A self-directed environment where you can take initiative to shape your role and career

  • Compensation: Market-competitive compensation including, for most roles, exposure to pre-launch tokens

In addition, 0G Labs is committed to the health and well being of all of our team members. To that end, we provide reimbursements towards a holistic set of experiences and courses:

  • Core self: Transcendental Meditation

  • Mind: Landmark Education

  • Emotion: Art of Communication

  • Presence: Speech Coach

  • Body: Fitness, gym and exercise memberships/classes

title: Fractional Product Lead - 3 month contract
description: We're customer obsessed. We put the customer at the heart of everything we do - and we're looking for people who feel the same way. About Bike Club Bike Club is the easiest way to keep kids on the right sized bike. Through our subscription model, we remove the hassle of buying, outgrowing and reselling children's bikes, so families always have the right bike, right when they need it. We are a purpose led, fast-growing business built on ease, care, progress and joy - with a relentless focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling. Role Summary and Engagement Bike Club is looking for a fractional Product Lead to lead the member product, turn customer needs and commercial priorities into a clear direction and a prioritised roadmap, and deliver measurable improvements. The role combines senior Product leadership with practical discovery and delivery coordination in a lean team. The Product Lead will also establish an AI-enabled Product function, using AI to speed up customer insight, discovery, prototyping and experimentation. They will identify where AI and automation can improve the member experience or business efficiency, and turn the strongest opportunities into prioritised, measurable initiatives. This is a part-time fixed-term employment or freelance contract estimated at 3 days per week for a period of 3 months. Key Responsibilities Product direction and roadmap: own the direction and roadmap across the member lifecycle: joining, managing a subscription, ongoing membership, exchange and retention. Balance member value with operational efficiency, cost and business priorities. Discovery: lead discovery with members and colleagues across Marketing, Customer Service, Operations and markets. Use research, behavioural data and service insight to define problems before committing to solutions. Lifecycle and retention: work jointly with Marketing and the retention owner on lifecycle journeys, retention initiatives, experiments and shared measures. Product owns the supporting experience and requirements. Marketing owns campaign and channel execution. Requirements and backlog: turn agreed priorities into clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. Maintain one prioritised product backlog, including operational improvements and approved AI or automation initiatives. Investment cases: build proportionate cases for investment, setting out expected benefits, cost, dependencies and how outcomes will be measured. Recommend stopping or deferring work where value is insufficient. Delivery: agree delivery commitments with Engineering using realistic estimates and available capacity. Coordinate stakeholders, adoption and launches with the combined QA and Delivery role, keeping risks and changes visible. Marketing autonomy: support Marketing with appropriate content, landing-page and experimentation capabilities. Agree the boundary between the member product, CRM and support tools. AI in Product work: use AI routinely for research synthesis, analysis, requirements development, prototyping and experiment design, and validate findings against customer evidence. Prioritise valuable applications with Marketing, Customer Service, Operations and the Data and Automation function. Test assumptions and build proportionate business cases. Customer-service automation should support the wider member journey. Share responsibility with Marketing for using AI to support lifecycle insight, proposition testing and retention experiments, with agreed measures of customer and commercial impact. Leave things in a better state: because the engagement is part-time and time-limited, document the roadmap, backlog, ways of working and AI approach so the team can continue without the Product Lead, and hand over clearly at the end. Requirements Extensive Product Management experience including owning a digital product roadmap and delivering measurable customer and commercial improvements, preferably in a subscription, membership or related consumer business. Strong discovery skills, including customer interviews, journey mapping, data interpretation, problem definition and testing assumptions before investment. Commercial judgement: can compare value, effort, cost and risk, build practical investment cases and make clear prioritisation decisions. Ability to lead across functions, challenge senior stakeholders constructively and maintain focus when priorities compete. Experience working with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Customer Service and Operations through delivery, launch and continuous improvement. Demonstrable experience embedding AI into Product workflows, with examples of faster learning, better decisions or reduced effort. Able to distinguish valuable AI applications from features that add unnecessary complexity. Track record of working independently and effectively in a part-time, fractional or interim capacity, making visible progress in limited days a week. Able to start quickly, and leave behind clear documentation and repeatable ways of working. Measures Of Success Baselines, numerical targets, data sources and review dates are agreed with the executive sponsor and relevant business owners within the first 30 days. Delivery and outcomes are reviewed weekly. Member retention: improvement in the agreed retention or cancellation measure for targeted journeys, assessed jointly with Marketing and the retention owner. Member experience: improvement in self-service completion and reduction in avoidable support contact for prioritised journeys, without deterioration in customer experience. Conversion: improvement in agreed joining and exchange conversion measures, using experiments or comparable cohorts where practical. Speed of learning: reduced time from identifying a customer problem to testing a solution, with evidence that decisions remain grounded in customer insight. AI and automation: validated initiatives deliver agreed improvements in member experience, retention or operational efficiency, measured with the relevant business owner. Roadmap value: proportion of priority initiatives with a stated outcome, baseline and measurement plan before delivery, followed by a documented benefits review. Delivery confidence: performance against jointly agreed milestones, with changes in scope, priorities and dependencies recorded and communicated early. Our Values We look for people who live our values every day: Ease: we make things simple for our members and for each other. Care: we look after our customers, our colleagues and our bikes. Progress: we keep improving, learning and raising the bar. Joy: we help kids fall in love with cycling, and enjoy the work we do. Why Bike Club? You'll be joining a business with a clear purpose, a genuinely different proposition and significant opportunity to grow. This is a rare opportunity to build the operating system for our national refurbishment and distribution site from the ground up, shaping how Bike Club gets the right bike to every family, right when they need it. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. The role

HEX brings together creative talent, emerging technology and industry-leading partners to turn innovation into scalable solutions for our clients.

We're looking for a Programme Director to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, high-profile programme at the intersection of creative production, AI and emerging technology.

You will translate strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan, bring multiple workstreams together and ensure the programme delivers against its commitments. You'll take ownership of programme governance, dependencies, risks and decisions, providing the clarity and control needed to navigate complexity and maintain momentum.

Working across senior leadership, technology partners, clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you'll connect the bigger picture with the detail of execution, ensuring everyone is aligned on what needs to happen, when and why.

What you'll do

Lead the programme

  • Own the integrated programme plan, translating objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, deliverables and success measures.
  • Establish effective governance, clear accountability and a consistent approach to programme reporting and decision-making.
  • Maintain oversight of the critical path, dependencies and delivery commitments, ensuring activity across workstreams comes together to achieve the overall programme objectives.
  • Provide a clear view of programme health, progress and emerging issues, giving leadership the information needed to make timely, informed decisions.

Drive delivery

  • Lead delivery across multiple workstreams, aligning teams on priorities, milestones and interdependencies.
  • Anticipate risks, resolve blockers and drive action on issues before they impact delivery.
  • Manage changes to scope, timelines and deliverables, assessing their implications and ensuring trade-offs are agreed and understood.
  • Challenge assumptions, address competing priorities and keep teams focused on the outcomes that matter most.
  • Hold workstream leads accountable for commitments, following through on actions and intervening where delivery is at risk.

 

Align clients and stakeholders

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP, technology partners and client organisations.
  • Create alignment across teams with different priorities, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and a shared understanding of programme objectives.
  • Lead programme reviews and executive reporting, communicating progress, risks, decisions and required actions with clarity.
  • Act as the central point of coordination for programme delivery, connecting stakeholders and ensuring commitments translate into action.

Deliver measurable outcomes

  • Maintain oversight of performance against programme objectives, milestones, budgets and agreed commercial commitments, working with the relevant commercial and finance leads.
  • Define and track success measures that demonstrate client adoption, business impact and value delivered.
  • Identify emerging delivery or commercial risks, making their implications visible and driving appropriate action.
  • Use performance data and programme insight to inform decisions, address underperformance and improve outcomes throughout the programme lifecycle.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience leading complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, interdependent deliverables and senior stakeholders.
  • A proven track record of translating strategic objectives into executable plans and delivering against challenging commitments.
  • Strong programme management expertise across integrated planning, governance, critical path management, risk, dependencies and change control.
  • The judgement to anticipate problems, navigate ambiguity and make effective decisions when priorities or delivery conditions change.
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and hold teams accountable across matrixed organisations.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, forecasts and performance against agreed commitments.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and executive-level reporting.
  • A proactive, collaborative approach, combining attention to detail with a clear focus on overall programme objectives.

Experience in creative production, digital transformation, AI-enabled programmes or technology partnerships would be advantageous.

What success looks like

  • A clear, integrated programme plan that connects workstreams, milestones, dependencies and outcomes.
  • Predictable, well-controlled delivery, with risks anticipated, blockers resolved and commitments actively managed.
  • Clear accountability across workstreams and strong alignment between clients, partners and delivery teams.
  • Timely, informed decision-making supported by transparent reporting and a reliable view of programme performance.
  • Measurable client outcomes, with clear evidence of adoption, business impact and value delivered.
  • A programme that meets its objectives while adapting effectively as priorities and requirements evolve.

You will also lead a small regional specialist team and support multiple projects across Europe.

· Own the development and continuous improvement of a standardised, scalable EMEA BMS product, including regional specifications, control philosophies and engineering standards.

· Define repeatable system architectures, sequences of operation, hardware and software, networks, communications, graphics, alarms and equipment interfaces, with appropriate resilience and cybersecurity.

title: Inventory Specialist
description: The opportunity We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with ownership and a direct line to the founders. Youʼll help make sure laboratory teams have the consumables they need, when they need them. Youʼll have a say in the software they use to manage stock, and learn to use AI to make everyday purchasing and inventory work easier. About us AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one. We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team. The role This is a hands-on, early-career role within our Infrastructure team. Youʼll manage day-to-day consumables purchasing, receive deliveries and keep stock records accurate, with training and guidance from your manager and laboratory colleagues. As you learn the work, youʼll organise your day independently and follow issues through to resolution. Youʼll work with laboratory teams to understand demand, place orders within agreed budgets and approvals, and chase delays before they disrupt work. Youʼll maintain supplier prices and lead times, flag supply risks and get laboratory approval for any proposed substitutions. At goods receipt, youʼll check orders against deliveries, including quantities, condition and relevant batch, expiry and temperature requirements. Youʼll record receipts promptly, route goods to the right storage and resolve discrepancies. Youʼll help physically set up storage areas, organise stock into defined bin locations and label and barcode those locations so they match the inventory records. Youʼll record stock movements and investigate differences found during stock counts. With guidance, youʼll propose reorder points and buffer stock using consumption, lead times and planned activity. Youʼll track expiry dates, prioritise the earliest-expiring stock where appropriate and maintain consistent item codes, units and pack conversions. Youʼll document procedures, follow safety and quality requirements, and segregate items awaiting review. Regular updates on supply risks and stock accuracy, together with reliable receipt records, will help colleagues in the lab and finance. Youʼll work directly with software engineers to shape the inventory tools you use every day. Youʼll bring ideas from the lab, explain what needs to work differently and test new features against real tasks. Your input will help decide what gets improved, with your manager and the software team leading priorities, design and development. Youʼll also learn to use AI-assisted workflows for tasks such as reviewing inventory data and preparing routine updates, then help refine those workflows as you find better ways to work. Training and support will be part of the role. Your first 90 days FIRST 30 DAYS ◆ Learn the consumables, storage requirements and approval processes with laboratory colleagues. Take on routine ordering and goods receipt with support. ◆ Check stock records against physical inventory and map the journey from purchase request to use. Agree a practical storage layout and bin-location scheme with laboratory colleagues, taking account of access and storage requirements. DAYS 30 TO 60 ◆ Run routine ordering, receipts and stock counts independently within agreed processes. Keep colleagues informed of shortages, overdue orders and expiring stock. ◆ Physically set up and organise the agreed storage areas, label and barcode bin locations, and link them to inventory records. Propose replenishment settings with your manager and laboratory colleagues, and document how stock is stored and moved. Turn recurring problems into examples for the software team. DAYS 60 TO 90 ◆ Check that colleagues can find, receive and return stock using the labelled and barcoded locations. Resolve gaps in the layout or records, and refine replenishment to reduce avoidable shortages and waste. ◆ Test available inventory features against everyday tasks and help colleagues adopt improvements. With support, try an AI-assisted workflow for a routine task, check its outputs and suggest how to improve it. Who you are Youʼre proactive, organised and attentive to detail, and you enjoy practical work where accurate records have visible consequences. When a problem arises, you flag it promptly and investigate practical solutions while keeping colleagues informed. You act within agreed processes, bring options when a decision needs support and follow the issue through to resolution. Your experience may come from inventory, purchasing, logistics or laboratory operations, including an apprenticeship or placement. A scientific degree and coding experience are not required. We welcome transferable experience with physical stock and time-sensitive supplies. Youʼre willing to help beyond a fixed task list as the team grows, while using judgement about when to escalate. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you. MUST HAVE ◆ Practical experience of inventory, purchasing, goods receipt, logistics or laboratory operations. ◆ Careful record-keeping and an organised approach to checking deliveries, prioritising work and following actions through. ◆ Confidence with digital tools and a willingness to learn to use AI, check its outputs and improve recurring workflows over time. Prior AI expertise is not required. ◆ Clear communication with suppliers and colleagues, including explaining an operational problem to a software developer. NICE TO HAVE ◆ Experience with laboratory consumables or expiry-sensitive and temperature-controlled stock. ◆ Familiarity with inventory or ERP systems, barcode-based stock control, or testing new software. Why this is unusual Alongside keeping supplies moving, youʼll help shape the software and AI-assisted workflows that make the job easier. Youʼll work with engineers to turn a stock discrepancy or awkward receiving step into a better tool, then see whether it works in practice. Youʼll build experience in improving systems as well as running the day-to-day operation. Youʼll have support as you learn, and room to contribute ideas from the start. Some people find that mix energising; others prefer a more settled routine. It is worth knowing which suits you. How we work This role is primarily on-site in Kingʼs Cross, London, typically four to five days a week, because deliveries and physical inventory need someone there. The wider team is distributed, so we write things down and keep colleagues informed. We start the week with an all-hands and share written updates. We give feedback directly and expect good ideas to be challenged on their merits, whoever proposes them. UK benefits include 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution after a three-month deferment, and Bupa private health cover. The team you will join Youʼll join the Infrastructure team and work closely with laboratory colleagues, software engineers and finance. Your manager will help set priorities and support decisions on inventory planning and wider process changes. Youʼll bring the day-to-day operational view into those discussions. Our process We start with a short screening conversation, followed by a behavioural interview. Weʼll ask for examples of how youʼve spotted a problem, kept others informed and taken practical steps to solve it, including when you sought support. Next comes a role-specific work sample and a discussion of how you approached it, followed by references. Weʼll explain the assessment format in advance, and youʼll meet us in person before any offer. If the role interests you, apply through the person who introduced you or the recruiter who shared it. If youʼre unsure whether you meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. We are an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions on merit, scope-fit, and the strength of the working relationship we expect to build with each hire. Applications welcome from candidates of any background. Please indicate your preferred working schedule in your cover letter.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>About us</strong></p> <p>Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved.&nbsp; Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.</p> <p>Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&amp;D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the role&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Systems Engineering bridges the gap between Riverlane and its customers. They act as the primary technical interface for our customers’ engineers to guide them through product integration and help with troubleshooting complex quantum systems. They are key to securing design wins and driving product development.</p> <p>As an FPGA Engineer, you will configure our Deltaflow Hardware to connect Quantum Computers to provide low-latency, high throughput systems that perform complex operations in a predictable and guaranteed way.&nbsp; You will use your knowledge and expertise to adapt the hardware to an ever-changing quantum control system to support scientists that are running quantum experiments.</p> <p>This is a fantastic opportunity to join Riverlane’s team, that is developing the world’s most advanced quantum error correcting algorithms.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Riverlane team is a mix of mathematicians, physicists and engineers, working together on a range of exciting and cutting-edge projects.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Technical pre-Sales:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Host Technical Workshops on Riverlane’s QEC Interface</li> <li>Evaluate Customers Control System and Data Communication requirements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Integration On-Site: </strong>End-to-End System Deployment:</p> <ul> <li>Writing RTL to adapt to customers control systems and ensure data packets are received correctly.</li> <li>Work with Riverlane’s Quantum Application Team to design experiments to test the system.</li> <li>Benchmark and discover hardware latency limitations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Troubleshooting and Debugging: </strong>Managing Customer Issues:</p> <ul> <li>Report issues and help replicate the setup with the QA team in Riverlane.</li> <li>Writing script to debug and trace faults</li> <li>Update verification environment and the test vectors based on data gathered from the experiments that were conducted.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Customer Advocacy: Voice of the Customer to Riverlane Product Team:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Highlight the success, issues and trends on customer’s Quantum Systems</li> <li>Feedback key features that will be needed to win current and next generation products</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with state-of-the-art FPGA platforms (e.g. AMD/Xilinx MPSoCs/RFSoCs, Altera Stratix 7 or Stratix 10)&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in writing SystemVerilog or VHDL</li> <li>Proven professional experience in <strong><em>at least one of</em></strong> the following areas:&nbsp; <ul> <li>Implementation of modern classical decoders on FPGA e.g. LDPC, turbo-codes;&nbsp;</li> <li>Implementation of Ethernet and High-Speed Protocols&nbsp;</li> <li>Implementation of customs protocols and standards.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Proven capability to test, debug and improve UVM Verification Environment.</li> <li>Good knowledge of Python and C++</li> <li>Ability to convert product requirements into technical specifications to document and share your work</li> <li>A curious nature and a passion for learning and continuous improvement&nbsp;</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team</li> </ul> <p>Typically, our Senior FPGA Engineers have around 4–8 years of relevant experience, though this can vary by background.</p> <p><strong>Even better if you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience of working on scientific instrumentation</li> <li>PhD in a relevant subject</li> <li>Good knowledge of quantum mechanics.</li> learning environment that encourages individual, team and company growth and development, including a regular programme of learning events and training and conference budgets</li> </ul> <p><strong>How What is Finary?

We are on a mission to give power back to investors. Great financial guidance has always existed, it just came with a minimum net worth. We're changing that by building the AI-powered one-stop shop for investing, where you can track your assets, manage your budget, invest, and learn. One simple, ambitious idea drives us: put a private banker in everyone's pocket.

Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1,000,000 people now trust us with their financial lives. We ship cutting-edge products with touches of delight, and we care deeply about experience, performance, and ease of use.

Why now?

A new generation of investors is emerging: ambitious, involved, done with taboos around money. We see a world where investing empowers everybody to live the life they've always dreamt of. To fuel that, we raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator, and Speedinvest, alongside founders and operators like Steve Anavi & Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (former UBS Chairman), and Harsh Sinha (CTO at Wise).

In July 2026, the AMF granted us our MiCA license, on top of our Investment Firm license: one of the very few French platforms holding both, offering stocks, ETFs and crypto on a single regulated platform, right as Europe consolidates around licensed players. There's never been a more exciting time to join.

What we offer

We're 70 builders who genuinely love what they do: real ownership from day one, tier-1 salary and equity, offices in the heart of Paris with hybrid remote, and quarterly gatherings we actually look forward to.

We hire A-players who are as kind as they are demanding, people whose ideas transform not just our product but the way we work and think. Our culture is direct, transparent, and built on radical candor: we challenge each other openly, then commit. And we don't hedge on AI. It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. If that's already second nature to you, you'll be surrounded by people pushing that frontier every day.

Read more about our values here.

Context: where you'd have impact

Finary (YC W21, 25M€ Series B) is building the leading wealth management platform in Europe. Some numbers:

  • 1M+ users on the platform

  • A YouTube channel with 850k+ subscribers and 5-10M monthly views, our main acquisition engine

  • Finary One, our private offering for 1M€+ portfolios, growing fast

Our #1 growth challenge: converting our 1M+ users into paying subscribers to drive revenue.

Our #2: feeding qualified leads to Finary One through content and growth work. The growth team today is 2 people plus AI agents doing the work of many more.

Everything you ship moves a metric someone looks at weekly.

Nothing you do will be "intern work" that sits in a drawer.

About the role

You will join as a Growth Intern with a hybrid scope: hands-on growth execution across channels, plus data and automation work that makes the whole team faster. The team is AI-native: we automate everything that can be automated and spend our time on what moves the needle. This is not a "watch and learn" internship. You ship from week 1.

Missions

Growth execution

  • Create and manage content across platforms (YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok)

  • Support SEO and website work: blog articles, optimization, keyword research

  • Build and optimize CRM campaigns to convert free users into subscribers

  • Assist on paid marketing: campaign setup, monitoring, optimization

  • Support Finary One lead generation, partnerships, PR, and brand initiatives

Data & automation

  • Build dashboards and reports to monitor performance across channels, including the YouTube-to-signup funnel

  • Design and implement automations to eliminate repetitive marketing and data workflows

  • Leverage AI tools extensively: agents, workflows, analysis, reporting

  • Bring data-driven recommendations to editorial and marketing meetings

What we look for


✅ Must-haves

  • AI-first mindset: uses AI daily to solve problems and accelerate work, beyond simple chat prompts

  • High agency: acts without waiting for permission and drives tasks to completion

  • Analytical rigor: structures problems, defines metrics, extracts clear insights from noisy data

  • Strong written communication in French and English

  • Genuine interest in personal finance and Finary's mission


✨ Nice to have

  • Python or no-code automation experience (n8n, Make, Zapier)

  • Familiarity with marketing analytics tools

  • A personal project that shows initiative

🚫 Dealbreakers

  • Low agency

  • Tool-first thinking without judgment

  • No interest in finance

Why Finary now

  • Series B momentum, building the #1 wealth management platform in Europe

  • Full-stack growth exposure, not siloed: acquisition, conversion, retention, lead gen

  • A-player team with high standards and a fast learning curve

  • Real ownership and tangible outcomes shipped in weeks, not months

Location: Paris (on-site)

Start date: asap

Duration: 6 months (negotiable according to your school's format)

Reporting to: Maxime Le Cleach, Product Growth

Interviews

Interviews with French-speaking candidates are held in French. As an international company, we expect a working level of English, which we test during the screening call.

raw.title: Ingénieur Patrimonial - Stage (Juillet 2027)
raw.description:
Qu'est-ce que Finary ?

Notre mission est de transformer la façon dont l'argent peut travailler pour vous. Nous construisons le one-stop-shop de l'investissement, où vous pouvez suivre votre patrimoine, gérer votre budget, investir et apprendre, afin de redonner le pouvoir aux investisseurs. Mounir a lancé Finary en 2021, et nous avons depuis franchi le cap du million d'utilisateurs. Nous livrons des produits à la pointe, avec ces petites attentions qui font la différence, et nous accordons une grande importance à l'expérience, à la performance et à la simplicité d'usage.

Pourquoi maintenant ?

Une nouvelle génération d'investisseurs émerge : ambitieuse et impliquée. L'argent n'est plus tabou, et le système de retraite est soumis à une pression énorme. Nous imaginons un monde dans lequel investir permet à chacun de vivre la vie dont il a toujours rêvé. Pour porter cette ambition, nous avons levé 25 M€ en Série B en septembre 2025, soutenue par PayPal Ventures, Hedosophia, Y Combinator et Speedinvest, aux côtés de fondateurs et d'opérateurs de classe mondiale comme Steve Anavi et Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (ancien président d'UBS) et Harsh Sinha (CTO de Wise). Et depuis juillet 2026, nous sommes l'un des très rares acteurs français à détenir à la fois un agrément d'Entreprise d'Investissement et un agrément MiCA, délivrés par l'AMF. Il n'y a jamais eu de moment plus stimulant pour nous rejoindre.

Ce que nous offrons

Nous recrutons des personnes qui élèvent le niveau de l'équipe : des A-players aussi bienveillants qu'exigeants. Nous avançons vite, nous visons haut et nous considérons l'ownership comme une évidence. Notre culture est directe, transparente et fondée sur les principes de radical candor et du lean management. Cet environnement correspond aux personnes qui aiment repousser leurs limites chaque jour.

Nous sommes convaincus que la maîtrise de l'IA est la compétence la plus importante de la décennie à venir, et c'est une véritable exigence ici, pas un simple mot à la mode. Chez Finary, chacun a repensé sa façon de travailler autour de l'IA. C'est le premier réflexe, pas une expérimentation annexe.

Pour en savoir plus sur nos valeurs : About Finary

Ce qui vous attend

  • Une équipe ultra-performante : travaillez avec des A-players dans chaque domaine, dans un environnement qui vous challenge et vous aide à progresser vite.

  • De l'ownership dès le premier jour : liberté, responsabilité et confiance.

  • Un impact qui compte : construisez un produit qui aide les gens à prendre en main leur avenir financier.

  • Un mode hybride : des coéquipiers partout en France et en Europe, qui se retrouvent en personne à Paris quatre fois par an.

A propos de Finary One

L'offre Finary One accompagne ses clients sur leurs enjeux patrimoniaux les plus complexes (protection, transmission, structuration, fiscalité) avec une approche indépendante, rigoureuse et centrée sur les besoins du client, et en synergie avec ses conseils juridiques.

Nous recherchons un·e stagiaire en ingénierie patrimoniale (6 mois, démarrage juillet 2027) pour intervenir sur trois volets : le suivi des dossiers clients, la veille juridique et fiscale, et la conception d'outils patrimoniaux next gen.

  • Assister le suivi des dossiers clients : préparation et participation aux meetings ; suivi des dossiers clients dans le temps

  • Contribuer à la réalisation des livrables clients sous quelle que forme que ce soit : mails, PowerPoint / Google slide, simulateurs ; dans le cadre de synthèse de discussion, mémos techniques, analyses patrimoniales globales etc.

Veille & formation juridique fiscale

  • Contribuer à la veille juridique et fiscale en interne (Monthly meeting ; lois de finances, etc)

  • Contribuer à la “Newsletter - Ingénierie patrimoniale” pour les clients Finary One

  • Contribuer à la réalisation de supports de présentation divers : documentation clients, fiches thématiques, guides pédagogiques etc.

Produit & innovation

  • Contribuer à la conception d'outils patrimoniaux next gen : simulateurs, diagnostic patrimonial, moteurs d’analyse et de recommandation

  • Contribuer à la rédaction de scripts vidéos/podcast/articles portant sur des thématiques d’ingénierie patrimoniale

  • Faire remonter les besoins terrain aux équipes produit et tech pour améliorer en continu les outils

  • Participer à l'intégration de l'IA dans les processus d'ingénierie patrimoniale

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre un acteur de référence : Intégrer l'un des principaux acteurs de la gestion de patrimoine digitalisée en France, positionné pour devenir la référence du secteur

  • Construire, pas simplement exécuter : Participer à la création et au développement d'un service d'ingénierie patrimoniale depuis ses fondations, avec un vrai rôle de structuration

  • Outils modernes et IA : Travailler au quotidien avec des outils technologiques de pointe, notamment basés sur l'intelligence artificielle

  • Combiner droit, fiscalité, finance et tech : Évoluer à l'intersection unique du juridique, du fiscal et de la technologie, une expertise rare et très valorisée sur le marché

  • Clientèle fortunée et stimulante : Traiter des sujets d'ingénierie patrimoniale sur des profils qu'on ne croise pas ailleurs : fondateurs et dirigeants d'entreprises, investisseurs, cadres tech, crypto-natifs, influenceurs, professions libérales etc.

  • Accélération de carrière : Formation accélérée au sein d'une entreprise en fort développement et à taille humaine ; variété des missions, transversalité des sujets et responsabilités rapides

  • Impact direct sur le produit : Contribuer activement à façonner le développement de Finary One

  • Visibilité et communauté : Bénéficier de l'audience et de la notoriété de Finary auprès de centaines de milliers d'utilisateurs passionnés de finance personnelle.

title: Ingénieur.e de recherche : Analyse de la chaine d'epuration de syngaz (H/F) - CDD 18 mois
description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Le poste est ouvert au sein le centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des Solides Divisés, de l'Énergie et de l'Environnement) UMR CNRS 5302 d’IMT Mines Albi, dans le cadre du projet de collaboration avec GRDF sur l’intégration de nouveaux gaz renouvelables dans le réseau de gaz naturel. Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. La plateforme VALTHERA est rattachée au centre RAPSODEE. Les travaux réalisés sur la plateforme le sont essentiellement à l’échelle pilote et sont centrés sur les procédés thermochimiques pour la production d’énergies renouvelables. GRDF est le gestionnaire du plus grand réseau de distribution de gaz en Europe. GRDF s’inscrit dans une trajectoire de décarbonation, avec une volonté de multiplier par cinq la production de gaz renouvelable pour attendre 20% de gaz renouvelable dans le réseau GRDF à l’échéance 2030, mais également d’aider les consommateurs de gaz à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Dans ce cadre, GRDF souhait renforcer la connaissance et maîtrise des procédés d'épuration du syngaz, étape clé pour garantir sa compatibilité avec les procédés de méthanation et, à terme, la production de méthane conforme aux exigences d’injection dans le réseau de gaz. DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : En qualité d’ingénieur de recherche, vous intégrerez une équipe comprenant des ingénieurs, techniciens et enseignants chercheurs travaillant dans la recherche sur les procédés thermiques de valorisation de biomasse et déchets. Le projet que vous devrez développer cherche à analyser les différentes technologies d’épuration à intégrer dans une chaîne d’épuration globale de gaz de synthèse. La chaîne d’épuration a un impact conséquent sur les coûts d’investissement et d’opérations du procédé de production de biogaz par gazéification de biomasse ou déchets. Il est essentiel de simplifier le schéma d’épuration et d’essayer de minimiser la génération d’effluents afin de réduire les coûts des opérations unitaires. Le choix des briques technologiques dépend de la qualité du gaz de synthèse produit qui dépend du gisement utilisé, de la technologie du gazéifieur et des conditions opératoires. raw.description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Le poste est ouvert au sein le centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des Solides Divisés, de l'Énergie et de l'Environnement) UMR CNRS 5302 d’IMT Mines Albi, dans le cadre du projet de collaboration avec GRDF sur l’intégration de nouveaux gaz renouvelables dans le réseau de gaz naturel.

Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. La plateforme VALTHERA est rattachée au centre RAPSODEE. Les travaux réalisés sur la plateforme le sont essentiellement à l’échelle pilote et sont centrés sur les procédés thermochimiques pour la production d’énergies renouvelables.

GRDF est le gestionnaire du plus grand réseau de distribution de gaz en Europe. GRDF s’inscrit dans une trajectoire de décarbonation, avec une volonté de multiplier par cinq la production de gaz renouvelable pour attendre 20% de gaz renouvelable dans le réseau GRDF à l’échéance 2030, mais également d’aider les consommateurs de gaz à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Dans ce cadre, GRDF souhait renforcer la connaissance et maîtrise des procédés d'épuration du syngaz, étape clé pour garantir sa compatibilité avec les procédés de méthanation et, à terme, la production de méthane conforme aux exigences d’injection dans le réseau de gaz.

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

En qualité d’ingénieur de recherche, vous intégrerez une équipe comprenant des ingénieurs, techniciens et enseignants chercheurs travaillant dans la recherche sur les procédés thermiques de valorisation de biomasse et déchets.

Le projet que vous devrez développer cherche à analyser les différentes technologies d’épuration à intégrer dans une chaîne d’épuration globale de gaz de synthèse. La chaîne d’épuration a un impact conséquent sur les coûts d’investissement et d’opérations du procédé de production de biogaz par gazéification de biomasse ou déchets. Il est essentiel de simplifier le schéma d’épuration et d’essayer de minimiser la génération d’effluents afin de réduire les coûts des opérations unitaires. Le choix des briques technologiques dépend de la qualité du gaz de synthèse produit qui dépend du gisement utilisé, de la technologie du gazéifieur et des conditions opératoires.

Le projet n’inclut pas de travail expérimental. Il sera basé exclusivement sur l’analyse bibliographique et la modélisation 0D de la chaîne d’épuration. La modélisation sera réalisée via des logiciels commerciaux et plus idéalement grâce à des logiciels Open source.

Les principales tâches que le candidat retenu devra prendre en charge sont :

·       La réalisation d’un état de l’art des différentes briques technologies de traitement et d’épuration de biogaz, ainsi que des différentes chaînes existantes dans la littérature.

·       Une meilleure appréhension de l’impact de la composition des gisements sur la qualité du gaz en sortie du gazéifieur et l’impact de celui-ci sur la chaine d’épuration.

·       L’identification des verrous techniques, des incertitudes et des lacunes de connaissances limitant la maîtrise des différentes briques technologiques.

·       Une proposition de modèles des chaines d’épuration (simulation 0D) afin d’établir les bilans de matières et d’énergie et d’estimer la performance globale du procédé.

·       L’identification de critères permettant de guider les choix de construction d’une chaîne d’opérations.

·       La participation aux réunions de suivi du projet et la rédaction des comptes-rendus de réunion.

·       La rédaction de rapports du projet en français et des publications scientifiques en anglais et la création de supports de présentation.

 

CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES :

Ce poste nécessite des compétences en génie des procédés, procédés thermiques, thermodynamique et modélisation de procédés. Le candidat doit avoir une expérience dans la modélisation 0D des procédés. La connaissance et la pratique d’un ou plusieurs logiciels de simulation de procédés libres ou commerciaux sera considéré un plus.

 

Le candidat doit faire preuve rigueur, être doté d’un bon sens de l’analyse et savoir travailler en autonomie au sein d’une équipe. Les qualités d’analyse bibliographique et rédactionnelles sont un point essentiel pour ce poste.

description: Rejoignez l’aventure Joivy : L’art de vivre (et de travailler) à l’européenne ! Joivy est bien plus qu’une plateforme immobilière : c’est le premier écosystème résidentiel d’Europe conçu pour accompagner chaque étape de la vie. Du coliving au design soigné aux escapades en location de vacances, en passant par le logement étudiant ou des espaces de coworking inspirants, nous créons des lieux où l’on se sent immédiatement chez soi. Un écosystème innovant pour tous les besoins Joivy est l’alliance stratégique de pionniers tels que DoveVivo, Altido, Chez-Nestor et Open . Ensemble, nous redéfinissons les codes du marché : Pour nos résidents : Une offre flexible (colocations, studios, villas) pour des séjours de toutes durées, portée par une expérience numérique fluide. Pour nos partenaires : Un accompagnement premium pour les propriétaires et investisseurs, de la gestion d'actifs à la transformation immobilière grâce à l'intelligence artificielle et des outils d'analyse de pointe. L’aventure Joivy en quelques chiffres clés : Une expertise unique : 450 talents passionnés de plus de 30 nationalités (moyenne d’âge de 32 ans). Une présence XXL : 50 destinations à travers 7 pays (Italie, Espagne, France, Portugal, UK, Luxembourg et Bulgarie). Une force de frappe globale : Près de 2 000 propriétaires accompagnés et plus de 150 000 utilisateurs conquis. Tu joueras un rôle clé au cœur de la qualité de notre service client. Tu évolueras au sein d’une équipe experte et bienveillante, dans un contexte de structuration et de montée en puissance de notre nouveau pôle Quality and Process.   Missions : Pilotage au quotidien : planifier l'ensemble des prestations dans le CRM pour garantir une couverture parfaite du parc. Logistique terrain : organiser les tournées des prestataires (clés et accès) en présentiel à Paris et à distance pour les autres régions. Contrôle qualité : veiller à l'excellence des prestations réalisées et résoudre rapidement les imprévus du terrain. Management & optimisation : animer le réseau de prestataires et réinventer nos processus d'assignation pour gagner en efficacité. Missions transversales (Projets ménage & check-out) : Suivi financier : contrôler la conformité des factures prestataires et fluidifier le circuit de validation pour le pôle ménage. Ton profil Tu prépares un diplôme en école d'immobilier, d'hôtellerie ou en gestion de projet. Tu fais preuve d'une rigueur absolue et d'un grand sens du détail pour garantir la qualité de chaque intervention. Tu possèdes une excellente aisance relationnelle pour échanger efficacement avec nos prestataires sur le terrain. Tu es très à l'aise avec les outils digitaux et maîtrises les bases d'Excel. Tu maîtrises le français à l'oral comme à l'écrit (la maîtrise de l'anglais est un vrai plus). Pour que ton expérience chez Joivy France soit aussi enrichissante que stimulante, nous mettons tout en œuvre pour t'offrir un cadre de travail privilégié : Un stage rémunéré qui reconnaît ton engagement et ta contribution réelle à nos succès. Intègre une communauté unie, motivée et collaborative, où l'entraide est le moteur de chaque défi relevé. Entre nos afterworks mémorables, nos compétitions de tir au Nerf légendaires et nos petits-déjeuners conviviaux chaque mardi, la cohésion est notre priorité. Profite de 2 jours de télétravail par semaine (au bout de trois mois d’ancienneté) pour concilier au mieux tes missions et ta vie personnelle. Des tickets restaurant d'une valeur de 9 €/jour (via carte Edenred), et la prise en charge à 50% de ton abonnement de transport. L'accès exclusif aux dad jokes incontournables de notre collègue Loeiz, garanties 100% authentiques pour illuminer tes journées.   • élaborer et mettre à jour des tableaux de bord RH et des indicateurs de pilotage destinés aux besoins internes et aux instances de gouvernance ;

  • produire des analyses statistiques, des études prospectives et des rapports périodiques sur les ressources humaines ;

  • développer des outils de suivi permettant d’anticiper les besoins en effectifs, en compétences et en développement des talents;

  • assurer le contrôle de la qualité, de la cohérence et de l’intégrité des données RH ;

  • contribuer à l’élaboration et au suivi des indicateurs de performance de la fonction RH ;

  • garantir la confidentialité et la sécurisation des données conformément aux règles applicables au sein de l’Organisation ;

  • participer à l’administration fonctionnelle des outils et systèmes d’information RH ;

  • contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de collecte, d’exploitation et de restitution des données RH ;

  • accompagner le déploiement de nouveaux outils numériques et de solutions décisionnelles en matière de gestion des ressources humaines ;

  • fournir aux responsables RH et aux gestionnaires des analyses permettant d’éclairer les décisions relatives aux effectifs, aux compétences et à la gestion des talents ;

  • contribuer à la préparation des rapports institutionnels et des documents destinés aux organes de gouvernance ;

  • participer aux projets de transformation et de modernisation de la fonction RH ;

  • réaliser toute autre tâche confiée par le Chef du SRH selon les besoins du service.


Le/La candidat(e) au poste devra :

  • être ressortissant(e) d’un État ou gouvernement membre de l’OIF ;

  • être titulaire d’un diplôme universitaire de niveau Master au minimum en statistiques, économie, mathématiques appliquées, informatique décisionnelle, gestion des ressources humaines, gestion des données ou dans tout autre domaine pertinent ;

  • justifier d’une expérience professionnelle d’au moins trois (3) ans dans l’analyse de données, l’intelligence décisionnelle ou la gestion de données RH ;

  • avoir une bonne connaissance des indicateurs et processus de gestion des ressources humaines ;

  • maîtriser les outils d’analyse et de visualisation de données (Power BI, Tableau, Excel avancé ou équivalent, VBA) ;

  • avoir une expérience significative de l’utilisation de l’IA dans l’exploitation des outils Power bi, Excel, VBA, etc.

  • maîtriser les techniques statistiques ainsi que les méthodes d’analyse quantitative ;

  • avoir une expérience des systèmes d’information RH (SIRH) et des bases de données ;

  • posséder de solides capacités d’analyse, de synthèse et de présentation des résultats ;

  • avoir une excellente maîtrise de la langue française, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit ;

  • faire preuve de rigueur, de sens de l’organisation et d’une grande attention à la qualité des données ;

  • la connaissance des langages SQL, Power Query, VBA, Python et DAX sera un atout.
